newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Village sees 25/30 pct rise in profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Village sees 25/30 pct rise in profit.

text.p: Cinema operator Village Roadshow Ltd said on Wednesday that it expected its 1996/97 first half net operating profit to be 25 percent to 30 percent above the year-ago result.
The company said operating profit before tax and abnormal items was expected to be higher by 13 to 18 percent.
The half year profit result would be released within two weeks, the company said in response to a share price query by the Australian Stock Exchange.

"The company believes that the operating profit before abnormal items, minorities and tax for the six months ended 31 December 1996 will exceed the previous corresponding period by approximately 13 percent to 18 percent.

"Further, the company believes that the operating profit after abnormal items, minorities and tax will exceed the previous corresponding period by approximately 25 percent to 30 percent," Village said.
The company said it was likely to report two abnormal items, one an expense and the other an income item, for the 1996/97 first half.
"The net value of these abnormal items is not material to the group results," it said.
Village reported a 40.7 percent rise in its 1995/96 first half net profit to A$20.56 million while operating profit rose to A$32.75 million from A$20.23 million.
